use_cases.name: Author, test and deploy a statutory rule pack
use_cases.goal: Turn a statutory notification into a versioned, effective-dated rule pack that reaches production only after a green golden suite and a named reviewer's sign-off.

stakeholders.interest: Deductions change on the notified effective date, not on the next application release.
Every computed figure traces to the notification that introduced it.
Superseded packs remain available so any past period can be recomputed as it stood.

use_cases.trigger: A statutory notification changes a rate, slab, threshold or form for a jurisdiction (for example a revised professional tax slab for Maharashtra).
preconditions: The notification text and its effective date are available to the compliance engineer.
The central pack currently in force is in EFFECTIVE state.
The golden case library (SCR-071) is reachable and the CI pipeline is healthy.
postconditions_success: A new pack version is PUBLISHED or EFFECTIVE with jurisdiction, effective_from, supersedes and a changelog citing the notification.
The prior version is marked SUPERSEDED from the new effective date and retained for as-at recomputation.
compliance.pack.deployed has been emitted once for pack_id + version and payroll, time and recompute consumers have been triggered.
postconditions_failure: The pack remains in DRAFT or TESTED and is not consumed by any computation.
The currently EFFECTIVE pack continues to apply unchanged.

main_flow.action: Drafts the pack on SCR-070 with jurisdiction, effective_from, supersedes, rules and a changelog citing the source notification; pack enters DRAFT.
Adds or extends golden cases on SCR-071 for every rule, each with inputs, expected output and the statute reference.
Runs the full golden suite in CI, records pass and fail counts, and moves the pack to TESTED only when there are zero mismatches.
Reviews the changelog and the green test run, then signs off; reviewer name and approval time are stored and the pack is PUBLISHED.
Deploys the pack independently of any application release, layering the state pack over the central pack, and emits compliance.pack.deployed.

alternate_flows.condition: The notification amends an existing pack rather than creating a new jurisdiction.
steps: Compliance engineer creates a new version with supersedes pointing at the current version; the current version is never edited in place.
On the new effective date the prior version moves to SUPERSEDED and is retained.
Platform holds the pack in PUBLISHED and schedules activation.
At 00:00 on effective_from the pack becomes EFFECTIVE and compliance.pack.deployed is emitted.
Reviewer records the requested change against the pack.
Pack returns to DRAFT for the engineer to amend.

exception_flows.condition: Any golden case returns an output different from its expected output.
exception_flows.handling: Build fails, pack returns to DRAFT, and the failing case IDs with expected and actual values are listed on SCR-070.

exception_flows.condition: A rule in the pack has no golden case.
exception_flows.handling: Platform refuses to start the test run and names the uncovered rule.

exception_flows.condition: Deployment is attempted with a non-green suite or without a recorded reviewer.
exception_flows.handling: Deployment is refused with the reason shown; no consumer receives the pack.

exception_flows.condition: The state pack references a central pack version that is not EFFECTIVE.
exception_flows.handling: Deployment is refused because the layer order cannot be resolved; the engineer is shown the missing central version.

exception_flows.condition: The changelog does not cite a source notification.
exception_flows.handling: Save is allowed as DRAFT but submission for testing is blocked until the citation is added.

nfrs: A golden suite of 340 cases completes in CI within 10 minutes.
Pack deployment requires no application downtime and no code release.
Superseded packs are retained and resolvable by as-at date for at least the statutory record retention period of the payroll data they computed.

user_stories.want: to draft a rule pack with jurisdiction, effective date, supersedes link and a changelog citing the notification
user_stories.so_that: every statutory figure Nucleus computes can be traced back to the legal source that introduced it

acceptance.given: a draft Maharashtra professional tax pack with effective_from 2026-10-01 and an empty changelog
acceptance.when: the engineer submits it for testing
acceptance.then: submission is blocked with the message that the changelog must cite the source notification

acceptance.when: the engineer saves version 4 with supersedes = version 3 and effective_from 2026-10-01
acceptance.then: version 4 is saved in DRAFT and version 3 remains EFFECTIVE for all periods up to 2026-09-30

user_stories.so_that: no untested or unreviewed statutory change can reach a payroll run

acceptance.then: the build fails, the pack returns to DRAFT and the single failing case is listed with expected and actual values

acceptance.given: a pack with 340 of 340 cases passing and no reviewer recorded
acceptance.then: deployment is refused citing the missing reviewer and the pack stays TESTED

user_stories.so_that: an employee at Chakan Works gets the Maharashtra slab while an employee at Peenya Works gets the Karnataka slab in the same run

use_cases.name: Prepare, file and close a statutory obligation
use_cases.goal: Ensure every statutory obligation for each entity and state is prepared from posted records, filed by a human and closed with evidence before its due date.

stakeholders.interest: One screen each morning shows what is due, by whom and with what evidence.
Challan amounts match the statutory heads in the salary journal.
Each closed obligation carries an acknowledgement reference and the records it was built from.

use_cases.trigger: An obligation's due date approaches on the calendar (for example the PF ECR and challan for August 2026 due 2026-09-15).
preconditions: The applicability matrix is configured for each entity and state.
An owner is assigned for each obligation type.
The payroll run for the period is in POSTED state before a pack can be prepared.
postconditions_success: The obligation is in Filed status with filed_on, ack_ref and evidence_ref recorded.
compliance.obligation.filed has been emitted with obligation_id + period as idempotency key.
The filing pack and the action ledger entry are retained against the obligation.
postconditions_failure: The obligation stays Due or Overdue on SCR-072 and remains visible on the compliance dashboard.
No filing pack built from unposted or typed figures exists.

main_flow.action: Generates the obligation calendar per entity and state from the applicability matrix, with authority, period, due date and owner.
Requests the filing pack; the Compliance Watcher agent assembles it from POSTED records only and logs the proposal in the action ledger.
Files on the statutory portal, attaches the acknowledgement as evidence, records the reference and closes the obligation.

alternate_flows.condition: The obligation does not apply to a state for the period (for example Tamil Nadu professional tax is half-yearly).
steps: Platform records the obligation as Not applicable with the reason and the next due date.
No filing pack is requested.

alternate_flows.condition: The owner finds a wrong value in a source record while reviewing the pack.
steps: Owner raises the correction through the owning process (for example a payroll correction run), never by editing the pack.
Once the corrected record is POSTED, the agent regenerates the pack.

exception_flows.condition: A record needed for the pack is not yet POSTED (for example run PR-2026-09-01 is in PRE_AUDIT).
exception_flows.handling: Pack generation is refused and the blocking run or record is named on SCR-072.

exception_flows.condition: A user attempts to type or overwrite a figure in the pack.
exception_flows.handling: The figure is read-only; only regenerating from posted records changes it.

exception_flows.condition: The owner tries to close the obligation without an acknowledgement reference.
exception_flows.handling: Closure is refused until ack_ref and the evidence file are supplied.

exception_flows.condition: The agent proposes to submit the filing itself.
exception_flows.handling: The proposal is rejected by policy; the agent may only prepare and the filing step stays with the human owner.

nfrs: The obligation calendar for two entities and five locations loads within 2 seconds at p95.
SCR-072 is readable offline on mobile with the last synchronised state labelled with its timestamp.
Filing packs and acknowledgements are retained for the statutory retention period (to be validated by Legal).

user_stories.want: an obligation calendar generated per entity and state with owner and due date
user_stories.so_that: I see on one screen every filing that falls due without maintaining a spreadsheet

acceptance.then: separate professional tax obligations appear for KA due 2026-09-20 and MH due 2026-09-30, each with owner E1007

acceptance.given: LE-02's Tamil Nadu professional tax is half-yearly
acceptance.then: OB-2026-0917 shows Not applicable with the next due date 2026-09-30

user_stories.so_that: the figures I file always equal what was paid and posted

acceptance.then: the request is refused and PR-2026-09-01 is named as the blocking run

use_cases.name: Generate statutory forms and registers for a location
use_cases.goal: Produce each applicable statutory form or register from live data in the state variant that matches the plant's registration, and retain it with its filing acknowledgement.

stakeholders.interest: Registers for an inspection are ready without manual compilation.
A state amendment is absorbed by configuration, not a code release.
Forms follow the prescribed state layout and contain no typed figures.

use_cases.trigger: An employee joins at a factory location, a register period ends, or a filing or inspection demand is received.
preconditions: The location's registration (state, establishment type, factory licence) is recorded.
Form definitions with applicability rule, frequency, due rule and template are configured per state.
Source records for the period (attendance, approved overtime, leave) exist.
postconditions_success: A statutory_form_instance exists for the period with file_ref and a gapless serial where the register requires one.
compliance.form.generated has been emitted for the obligation calendar and document vault.
Filed instances carry filed_on and ack_ref against the period.
postconditions_failure: No instance is created from incomplete or typed data; the gap is listed for the compliance owner.

main_flow.action: Resolves the applicable form set from the plant's registration (state and establishment type), not the company's registered office.
Binds the declarative query to the state template, renders the instance for the period and emits compliance.form.generated.
For a new joiner at a factory location, generates the joining forms including Form F as a step inside the joining chain.
Files the form, records the acknowledgement reference and retains the artefact against the period on SCR-073.

alternate_flows.condition: The trigger is a period end or a filing demand, not a joining.
steps: Platform skips joining-form generation for this occurrence.

alternate_flows.condition: A state notifies a revised layout for a register.
steps: Compliance owner activates the new effective-dated template version for that state.
Instances for periods from the effective date render on the new layout; earlier periods keep the old layout.

alternate_flows.condition: The form is a register maintained on site rather than filed.
steps: Owner marks the instance as retained for inspection with no external filing.

exception_flows.condition: The location has no registration or establishment type recorded.
exception_flows.handling: Form set resolution fails and the location is flagged to the compliance owner; no company-level fallback is used.

exception_flows.condition: Source data for the period is incomplete (for example overtime not yet approved).
exception_flows.handling: The instance is not generated; the missing records are listed and nothing may be typed in their place.

exception_flows.condition: A field required by Form F is missing from the employee record.
exception_flows.handling: The joining-chain step stays open with the missing field named, and appears as a blocker on SCR-060.

exception_flows.condition: The owner marks the form filed without an acknowledgement reference.
exception_flows.handling: The status change is refused until ack_ref is recorded.

nfrs: A monthly register for 500 workers renders within 30 seconds.
Generated forms are immutable once filed; corrections create a new instance linked to the original.
Forms reproduce the state's prescribed layout and field order (to be validated by Legal).

user_stories.want: the form set to be resolved from each plant's own registration
user_stories.so_that: three plants in three states each file their own correct set

acceptance.when: the H1 2026 muster roll is generated for each
acceptance.then: LOC-PLA produces FRM-36-2026-H1 on the Karnataka layout and LOC-CHN produces its Tamil Nadu equivalent on the Tamil Nadu layout

use_cases.name: Simulate a salary structure against the Labour Codes wage base
use_cases.goal: Let HR test a proposed salary structure for wage-base compliance, statutory cost and take-home impact before any live structure is changed.

stakeholders.interest: Employer statutory cost impact is known per cost centre before adoption.
Take-home changes are deliberate and explainable.
Only a compliant, costed scenario is put up for sanction.

use_cases.trigger: HR or compensation proposes a change to a salary structure (for example rebalancing allowances for grade band B).
preconditions: The user holds the compensation role required for SCR-052.
A rule pack covering the wage-base definition is EFFECTIVE or PUBLISHED for the simulation date.
Current salary structures for the selected population are available.
postconditions_success: A named, versioned simulation scenario is saved with inputs, results and the rule pack version used.
An adopted scenario creates a draft structure-change proposal; live structures are unchanged until that proposal is approved.
postconditions_failure: No scenario is saved, or the scenario is archived with a rejection reason; live structures are untouched.

main_flow.action: Opens SCR-052 and selects the population by entity, grade band and worker class, with the current structure as baseline.
Enters the proposed component split, such as Basic plus DA share and each allowance, for the population.
Computes the wage base under the applicable rule pack and runs the 50% floor test, showing any excess allowance treated as wages.
Computes employer PF, ESI and gratuity cost and employee take-home per employee and in aggregate for baseline and proposal.
Shows baseline and proposal side by side with deltas per component, per cost centre and per employee.
Saves the scenario with a name and shares it with Finance for review.
Reviews the cost impact and records comments against the scenario.
Adopts the scenario; the platform raises a draft structure-change proposal and leaves live structures unchanged.

steps: HR operations enters up to three proposals for the same population.
Platform shows all proposals against the baseline in one comparison.
Approver records a reason.
Platform archives the scenario as Rejected and retains it for reference.

exception_flows.condition: No rule pack covering the wage-base definition is effective or published for the simulation date.
exception_flows.handling: Simulation is refused and the missing jurisdiction and date are named.

exception_flows.condition: The proposed components do not sum to the stated CTC for an employee.
exception_flows.handling: Platform highlights the employees affected and blocks simulation until the split balances.

exception_flows.condition: The user lacks the compensation role.
exception_flows.handling: SCR-052 is not offered and the attempt is recorded in the audit trail.

nfrs: Simulation of 1,000 employees returns results within 5 seconds at p95.
Simulation never writes to live salary structures or payroll runs.
Results are reproducible from the stored scenario inputs and rule pack version.

user_stories.want: to see whether a proposed structure passes the 50% wage floor before it is adopted
user_stories.so_that: we do not discover a statutory shortfall after payroll has run (to be validated by Legal)

acceptance.given: a proposal for grade band B sets Basic plus DA at 40% of total remuneration
acceptance.then: the floor test fails for every affected employee and the amount treated as wages is shown per employee

acceptance.given: a revised proposal sets Basic plus DA at 52%
acceptance.then: the floor test passes and no excess allowance is reclassified

user_stories.want: the employer statutory cost delta by cost centre
user_stories.so_that: I can budget the change before it is approved

acceptance.given: a scenario covers 418 LE-01 employees
acceptance.then: the monthly employer PF, ESI and gratuity deltas are shown per cost centre and their sum equals the total delta

acceptance.given: Finance adds a comment to the scenario
acceptance.then: the comment is shown with Finance's name and timestamp

user_stories.want: adopting a scenario to create a draft proposal rather than change live pay
user_stories.so_that: no structure changes without the normal approval chain

acceptance.given: a scenario has passed the floor test
acceptance.then: a draft structure-change proposal is created and the live structure for grade band B is unchanged

acceptance.given: I reject a scenario with reason 'cost exceeds FY27 budget'
acceptance.then: the scenario shows Rejected with that reason

use_cases.name: Log, label and disclose AI inferences
use_cases.goal: Ensure every AI inference is logged, labelled and disclosed, and that no adverse decision about a person is taken by AI alone.

stakeholders.interest: Knows when AI was involved and can ask for a human review.
Can reconstruct what an agent saw, proposed and did.
Agent behaviour stays within the declared policy.

use_cases.trigger: Any agent or AI feature produces an inference (an answer, recommendation, score or proposed action).
preconditions: The agent principal is registered with a scoped role and declared tools.
Disclosure text and AI labelling policy are configured for the tenant.
postconditions_success: An inference log entry exists linking principal, purpose, model version identifier, input references, sources, output and any action ledger record.
The output was displayed with an AI label and disclosure.
Any decision about a person that used the inference names the accountable human.
postconditions_failure: The output is withheld from the user and the failure is recorded; no unlogged inference is shown or acted upon.

main_flow.action: Intercepts the inference request and records the principal, purpose, model version identifier and the tool scope applied.
Produces the output using only declared tools and data within its scoped role.
Writes the inference log entry with input hash, sources, output, confidence and timestamp before releasing the output.
Labels the output as AI-generated on every surface and shows the disclosure on first use and in context.
Where the output informs a decision about a person, requires a named human decision and stores it beside the AI recommendation.
Blocks any adverse outcome (rejection, warning, deduction) that has no recorded human decision.
Queries the inference log by person, agent and period on SCR-110 and exports the result.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee asks for a human review of an AI-assisted outcome.
steps: Platform creates a review task for HR operations with the inference log entry attached.
The outcome is held until a human records a decision.

alternate_flows.condition: The tenant admin changes the inference log retention period.
steps: The change is recorded with the admin's identity and applies to new entries only.

exception_flows.condition: The inference log cannot be written.
exception_flows.handling: The output is withheld (fail closed) and the user is told the assistant is unavailable.

exception_flows.condition: The agent attempts to call a tool that is not declared for its principal.
exception_flows.handling: The call is denied, the attempt is logged and the tenant admin is alerted.

exception_flows.condition: An adverse decision is submitted with only an AI recommendation.
exception_flows.handling: Submission is refused until a named human records the decision and reason.

nfrs: Logging adds no more than 50 ms at p95 to an inference.
Inference log entries are append-only and tamper-evident.
Auditor access to the log is read-only and itself logged.

user_stories.want: AI-generated content to be clearly labelled with a way to ask for a human
user_stories.so_that: I know when a machine was involved in something that affects me

acceptance.given: the assistant answers a leave policy question
acceptance.when: the answer is shown in the mobile app
acceptance.then: it carries an AI label and a link to request human review

acceptance.given: I request human review of an AI-assisted gate-pass rejection
acceptance.then: a review task is created for HR operations and the rejection is held until a human decides

user_stories.want: the system to stop me from finalising an adverse decision that only an AI recommended
user_stories.so_that: accountability for decisions about people stays with a person

acceptance.given: an agent recommends issuing a warning to E1042
acceptance.when: I try to issue it without entering my own decision and reason
acceptance.then: the action is refused and asks for my decision and reason

acceptance.given: I record my decision and reason
acceptance.then: the record shows both the AI recommendation and my name as the decision maker

user_stories.want: to search the inference log by employee and period
user_stories.so_that: I can reconstruct what an agent saw and did

acceptance.given: the Policy Assistant answered 1,240 questions in September 2026
acceptance.when: I filter the log by employee E1019 and September 2026
acceptance.then: only her entries are returned, each with sources and any linked action ledger record

acceptance.given: I export the filtered log
acceptance.then: the export is read-only and my access is itself recorded in the audit trail

use_cases.name: Manage DPDP consent, retention and erasure requests
use_cases.goal: Honour a data principal's consent choices and erasure requests while retaining what law requires, with a pre-erasure intimation and processor flow-down.

stakeholders.interest: Personal data is used only for consented purposes and erased when no longer needed.
Statutory payroll, PF and tax records survive erasure in the form the law requires.
Each erasure is evidenced, including confirmations from processors.

use_cases.trigger: A data principal withdraws consent or submits an erasure request, or a retention period expires.
preconditions: Purposes, lawful bases and retention periods are configured per data category (to be validated by Legal).
Processors handling personal data are registered with contact and flow-down terms.
The requester's identity can be verified.
postconditions_success: Eligible personal data is erased or anonymised across modules and processors.
Records under statutory retention are kept, minimised where possible.
An erasure certificate with timestamps and processor confirmations is in the audit trail and the requester has been informed.
postconditions_failure: No data is erased; the request remains open with its reason (for example legal hold) and the requester is informed.

main_flow.action: Submits an erasure request or consent withdrawal from self-service after identity verification.
Registers the request with timestamp, requester and the purposes and data categories affected.
Classifies each data category as erasable, retained under statute, or retained under legal hold, and drafts an erasure plan.
Reviews and approves the erasure plan, recording the basis for every retained category.
Sends the pre-erasure intimation to the data principal 48 hours before erasure (to be validated by Legal).
Erases or anonymises eligible data and instructs each processor to do the same, tracking confirmations.
Writes the erasure certificate to the audit trail with categories erased, categories retained and processor confirmations.
Closes the request and the platform informs the data principal of the outcome.

alternate_flows.condition: The principal withdraws consent for one purpose only (for example alumni contact).
steps: Platform stops processing for that purpose and records the withdrawal.
No erasure plan is created for other purposes.

alternate_flows.condition: The requester is a current employee.
steps: Platform limits erasure to optional data not needed for the employment relationship and explains what is retained.

exception_flows.condition: Identity cannot be verified.
exception_flows.handling: The request is held as Unverified and the requester is asked for verification; no data is changed.

exception_flows.condition: A legal hold exists (for example a pending inspection or dispute).
exception_flows.handling: Affected categories are retained, the hold reference is recorded and the requester is informed.

exception_flows.condition: A processor does not confirm erasure within the configured SLA.
exception_flows.handling: The request is escalated to the data protection officer and stays open until confirmation is received.

nfrs: Erasure completes across all modules within 72 hours of the intimation window ending.
Anonymised statutory records cannot be re-linked to the person from data held in Nucleus.
All personal data is stored and processed in a cloud region in India.

user_stories.want: to request erasure of my personal data after I leave
user_stories.so_that: data I no longer need the company to hold is removed

acceptance.then: the request is escalated to me and remains open

user_stories.so_that: I stay in control of optional uses of my data

acceptance.then: alumni communications stop and no other records are changed

acceptance.then: my record does not appear

use_cases.name: Switch payroll to labour code rule packs by effective date
use_cases.goal: Hold ready-to-activate rule packs for the consolidated labour codes and switch computations to them on the notified effective date without a release.

stakeholders.interest: The first payroll after the codes take effect computes correctly with no emergency fix.
Structures that breach the new wage definition are known in advance.
Registers and returns switch to the code formats on the same date.

use_cases.trigger: Rules under a consolidated labour code are notified, or a state notifies its rules under a code.
preconditions: Current statute packs are EFFECTIVE.
Draft labour code packs exist for wages, social security, industrial relations and occupational safety (to be validated by Legal).
postconditions_success: Labour code packs are EFFECTIVE from the notified date and the packs they replace are SUPERSEDED but retained.
A shadow comparison for at least one period has been reviewed and signed off.
postconditions_failure: Current packs stay EFFECTIVE and the code packs remain PUBLISHED but inactive.

main_flow.action: Maintains draft packs per code and jurisdiction on SCR-070, with changelogs citing the draft or final rules.
Builds golden cases on SCR-071 for each code rule, including wage definition and contribution base cases.
Runs the golden suite; packs move to TESTED only when every case passes.
Runs a shadow computation of the latest closed payroll period under the code packs without affecting live results.
Reviews per-employee differences between live and shadow results on SCR-052 and records findings.
Signs off the packs once the notification and effective date are confirmed.
Sets effective_from to the notified date and activates the packs at that date, superseding replaced packs.
Triggers recomputation for any open period on or after the effective date and notifies payroll and compliance owners.

alternate_flows.condition: A state notifies its rules later than the central code.
steps: The central code pack activates on its date.
The state pack activates on its own date, layered over the central pack.

exception_flows.condition: A golden case fails.
exception_flows.handling: The pack returns to DRAFT and cannot be scheduled.

exception_flows.condition: The effective date has not been notified.
exception_flows.handling: Activation is not possible; packs stay PUBLISHED and inactive.

exception_flows.condition: The state pack layer order conflicts with the central pack.
exception_flows.handling: Activation is refused and the conflict is named.

nfrs: Shadow computation of a 600-employee period completes within 15 minutes.
Activation requires no application downtime.

user_stories.want: a shadow run of a closed period under the code packs
user_stories.so_that: I see every employee whose pay would change before the codes go live

acceptance.given: August 2026 LE-01 payroll is closed for 412 employees
acceptance.when: a shadow run under the code packs completes
acceptance.then: a per-employee difference report is produced and live August results are unchanged

acceptance.given: the shadow run shows 37 employees with a changed PF base
acceptance.then: each of the 37 shows the old base, new base and the rule that caused the change

user_stories.want: to schedule code packs to activate on the notified date

use_cases.name: Run a confidential workplace harassment case
use_cases.goal: Receive, investigate and close a workplace harassment complaint confidentially within configured timelines and produce the annual report.

stakeholders.interest: Confidentiality and protection from retaliation.
A fair hearing with timely notice.
Timelines are met and the annual report is accurate (to be validated by Legal).

use_cases.trigger: An employee lodges a complaint through the confidential channel.
preconditions: An Internal Committee is constituted and its members are registered with the restricted case role.
Statutory timelines are configured in the rule pack (to be validated by Legal).
postconditions_success: The case is closed with findings, recommendations and the action taken, visible only to authorised roles.
The case is counted in the annual report without identifying parties.
postconditions_failure: The case remains open with its overdue timeline escalated to the presiding officer and compliance owner.

main_flow.action: Lodges a complaint through the confidential channel, describing incidents, dates and witnesses, with optional attachments.
Creates a restricted case visible only to Internal Committee members and acknowledges receipt to the complainant.
Reviews the complaint, records admissibility and starts the inquiry timeline.
Sends notice and a copy of the complaint to the respondent within the configured period and tracks the reply deadline.
Records hearings, statements and evidence against the case, each entry timestamped and immutable.
Records findings and recommendations and submits the inquiry report.
Records the action taken on the recommendations within the configured period.
Closes the case, informs both parties and includes anonymised counts in the annual report.

alternate_flows.condition: The complainant asks for conciliation before inquiry.
steps: Committee records the request and the settlement terms if reached.
Case closes as settled through conciliation.

exception_flows.condition: A member of the committee is named in the complaint.
exception_flows.handling: That member is excluded from the case and cannot see it.

exception_flows.condition: An inquiry milestone passes its configured deadline.
exception_flows.handling: The case is flagged overdue and escalated to the presiding officer and compliance owner.

exception_flows.condition: A user without the restricted case role attempts to open the case.
exception_flows.handling: Access is denied and the attempt is logged.

nfrs: Case data is encrypted with a key separate from general HR data.
Every access to a case is logged and reviewable by the presiding officer.

user_stories.want: to lodge a complaint that only the Internal Committee can see
user_stories.so_that: I can report without fear of exposure

acceptance.given: I lodge a complaint at 10:15 on 2026-10-12
acceptance.then: I receive an acknowledgement with a case number and my manager cannot see the case

acceptance.given: an HR operations user without the committee role searches for my case number
acceptance.then: no result is returned and the attempt is logged

user_stories.want: timelines tracked with overdue alerts
user_stories.so_that: inquiries finish within the configured period

acceptance.given: the inquiry window is configured as 90 days and the inquiry started on 2026-10-15
acceptance.when: day 80 is reached with no findings recorded
acceptance.then: the presiding officer receives a reminder showing 10 days remaining

acceptance.given: the window passes with no findings
acceptance.then: the case is flagged overdue and escalated to the compliance owner

user_stories.want: an annual report generated from closed and open cases
user_stories.so_that: I can submit the annual report without compiling it by hand

acceptance.then: it shows those counts with no names or identifying details

acceptance.given: one case is overdue
acceptance.then: the overdue case is counted in the pending column

use_cases.name: Maintain contract labour registers and returns
use_cases.goal: Keep the principal employer's contractor licences, registers and returns current from live deployment data.

stakeholders.interest: Only workers of licensed, compliant contractors are deployed.
Contractor invoices are not paid while statutory proof is outstanding.
Registers reconcile to deployment and attendance.

use_cases.trigger: A contractor is engaged or renewed, a register period ends, or a return falls due.
preconditions: The principal employer registration is recorded per location.
Contractors are registered with licence number, validity, PF and ESI codes (to be validated by Legal).
postconditions_success: Registers for the period are generated from deployment and attendance data.
The half-yearly or annual return is filed and its acknowledgement recorded.
postconditions_failure: A deployment is blocked or flagged; the register lists the missing data.

main_flow.action: Records each contractor's licence, validity dates, sites served, workforce ceiling and PF and ESI codes.
Tracks licence expiry and alerts the compliance owner 30 days before expiry.
Deploys contract workers to a site against an active contractor licence.
Uploads monthly PF and ESI challans for deployed workers.
Verifies challans against deployed headcount and flags shortfalls.
Generates the register of contractors and the register of workmen per location from deployment and attendance.
Generates the periodic return, files it on the statutory portal and records the acknowledgement.

steps: Compliance owner records the new licence and validity.
Platform clears the expiry alert.

exception_flows.condition: The contractor licence has expired or the workforce ceiling would be exceeded.
exception_flows.handling: Deployment is blocked and the reason is shown.

exception_flows.condition: A monthly challan is missing or short.
exception_flows.handling: The contractor is flagged and the related invoice is held for Finance review.

exception_flows.condition: A location has no principal employer registration.
exception_flows.handling: Register generation fails and the location is flagged.

nfrs: Registers for 200 contract workers render within 20 seconds.
Licence and challan documents are retained for the statutory period (to be validated by Legal).

user_stories.want: deployment to be blocked when a contractor's licence has expired
user_stories.so_that: we never use labour from an unlicensed contractor

acceptance.when: I deploy one of its workers from 2026-10-01
acceptance.then: the deployment is blocked with the message that the licence has expired

acceptance.given: the expiry is 30 days away
acceptance.then: the compliance owner receives a renewal alert

user_stories.want: the register of workmen generated from deployment and attendance
user_stories.so_that: the register always matches who actually worked

acceptance.given: two contractors have workers at LOC-PLA in September 2026
acceptance.then: it lists each worker under the right contractor with attendance days taken from the time records

acceptance.given: the August challan of one contractor has not been uploaded
acceptance.then: the contractor is flagged and its August invoice is held

use_cases.name: Produce workforce disclosures for sustainability reporting
use_cases.goal: Generate workforce metrics for sustainability reporting from posted records with lineage to the source data.

stakeholders.interest: Wage and headcount figures agree with the books.
Every disclosed figure can be traced to its records.

use_cases.trigger: The financial year closes or a disclosure is requested.
preconditions: Payroll for the year is POSTED.
Metric definitions (headcount, diversity, wages, turnover, safety incidents, training hours) are configured with their source queries.
postconditions_success: A locked disclosure set exists for the year with each metric linked to its query and source records.
postconditions_failure: The disclosure stays in draft with the failing metrics listed.

main_flow.action: Selects the financial year and entities for the disclosure.
Computes each configured metric from posted and approved records only.
Stores lineage for each metric: definition, query version, record count and as-at timestamp.
Reviews metrics and drills any figure to its underlying records within scope.
Confirms wage totals against the posted salary journals.
Locks the disclosure set and exports it in the reporting format.

steps: Owner corrects the source record through its owning process.
Platform recomputes the affected metric with new lineage.

exception_flows.condition: A period's payroll is not POSTED.
exception_flows.handling: The wage metric is not computed and the period is named.

exception_flows.condition: A user tries to edit a locked figure.
exception_flows.handling: The edit is refused; changes require a new version with reason.

nfrs: Small cohorts (fewer than 5 people) are suppressed in diversity breakdowns.
Recomputing a full year for 600 employees completes within 10 minutes.

user_stories.want: each disclosed metric to carry its lineage
user_stories.so_that: I can defend every number to an auditor

acceptance.given: FY 2025-26 payroll for LE-01 and LE-02 is POSTED
acceptance.then: each metric shows its definition, query version, record count and as-at timestamp

acceptance.given: I drill into total wages for LE-02
acceptance.then: it lists the posted runs whose totals sum to the disclosed figure

user_stories.want: locked disclosures that cannot be changed silently
user_stories.so_that: the published figures match the evidence

acceptance.given: the disclosure set is locked
acceptance.when: a user edits the headcount figure
acceptance.then: the edit is refused

acceptance.given: a correction is needed after locking
acceptance.when: a new version is created with a reason
acceptance.then: both versions are retained and the difference is shown

use_cases.name: Assign and enforce mandatory compliance training
use_cases.goal: Assign mandatory compliance training by rule, track it to completion and escalate overdue items.

stakeholders.interest: Evidence that every in-scope person completed required training.
Knows which team members are overdue.

use_cases.trigger: A person joins, changes role or location, or a refresher period lapses.
preconditions: Assignment rules exist for each mandatory course (for example harassment-prevention awareness within 14 days of joining; factory safety within 2 days for plant roles).
postconditions_success: Each in-scope person has an assignment with due date and completion evidence.
Overdue items have been escalated and are visible on the compliance dashboard.
postconditions_failure: Unassigned or overdue items are listed for HR operations to resolve.

main_flow.action: Evaluates assignment rules when a joining, role, location or refresher trigger fires.
Creates the assignment through the standard learning assignment mechanism with a due date.
Completes the course on SCR-063; completion evidence is stored.
Sends reminders 3 days before and on the due date.
Escalates overdue items to the manager, then to HR operations after 7 further days.
Reviews completion rates by course, location and entity and exports evidence.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee already holds a valid completion from a previous assignment.
steps: Platform links the existing completion and closes the assignment.

exception_flows.condition: A mandatory item is still open at the confirmation due date.
exception_flows.handling: Confirmation is blocked until completion.

exception_flows.condition: No rule matches a person's role and location.
exception_flows.handling: The person is listed as uncovered for HR operations to resolve.

nfrs: Rule evaluation for a 600-person tenant completes within 2 minutes.
Completion evidence is retained for the employment period plus the configured retention.

user_stories.want: mandatory training assigned automatically by rule
user_stories.so_that: no new joiner is missed
